title: Cantabil Retail India Ltd - 533267 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Cantabil Q1 FY27 revenue rose 13% to INR178.8 crores and EBITDA margin widened to 33.2%, but PAT margin slipped to 9.1%.
summary.overview: Standalone revenue grew 13% YoY to INR178.8 crores and EBITDA grew 21% to INR59.4 crores, with margin up to 33.2% from 30.8%. PAT grew about 11% to INR16.3 crores, but PAT margin was 9.1% versus 9.2% a year ago. Management attributed the margin gain to product mix and price increases passed to customers, and said July demand was moderate with festive timing shifting into Q3. Management reiterated the INR1,000 crore FY27 revenue target and about 5% SSG for the full year, relying on new stores and a Q2 opening push of 28-30 stores.

financial_highlights.value: 667 stores, 9.42 lakh sq ft retail area

segments.name: Retail stores (standalone)
segments.commentary: Q1 opened 15 stores totalling about 27,000 sq ft; average Q1 opening store size 1,810 sq ft. Average store sales were INR1.26 crore in FY26, with mature stores at about INR1.5 crore and stores under 1-1.5 years near INR1 crore.

segments.name: Online
segments.commentary: Online share fell to about 5% in Q1 from 6% in FY26 because of a software and end-to-end integration change; management targets 8% for FY27 and says online is run above EBITDA level.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue target of INR1,000 crores reiterated, implying about 18-19% growth; management split this into 10-12% volume growth plus inflation pass-through.
Full-year SSG target about 5% (management also cited a 5-6% long-term aspiration), with about 3% from price and balance from volume.
Average annual gross margin target of about 60% and EBITDA margin of 30% or more maintained; PAT margin ambition 11-12%.
Store additions of 28-30 in Q2 FY27 and about 55,000-60,000 sq ft; average store size target around 1,500 sq ft by year end.
Working capital cycle guided at 100-105 days; finished goods inventory target 110-120 days.
Management expects volume growth to pick up in Q3 as Diwali falls on about 10 November, and says Q2 volume growth will be limited.
capex_capacity: Q1 FY27 openings of 15 stores (about 27,000 sq ft); Q2 plan of 28-30 stores and 55,000-60,000 sq ft.
Store sizes are rising: average opening store 1,810 sq ft in Q1 versus about 1,500 sq ft average over the last two years.
Franchise store count fell from 178 (FY23) to 130 as the company moves to larger formats that franchisees find hard to fund in Tier 3 towns.
Around 20-25 stores close each year on performance, market or franchise issues; management calls this normal.
Inventory ageing: about 75% under 1 year, 20% 1-3 years, about 5% over 3 years (mainly surplus factory outlet).
demand_pricing: Same-store sales growth of 4.04% in Q1; volume growth about 7-8% against about 13% area growth.
Raw material prices up about 10% (earlier 20-25%); management says the full cost is being passed to customers with no volume impact, though cotton is up 10-15%.
July was moderate; Raksha Bandhan moved to late August (versus 10 August last year), so festive sales shifted and management declined to comment on the current quarter.
Management says it will not pursue premiumisation; ASP is about INR1,100 and is to be held there.
Competition: new-age and D2C brands are said to share about 50-60% of their basic casual and formal ranges with Cantabil; management frames the difference as roughly 40% of the collection.
Repeat customers are close to 50%; management is not launching a points-based loyalty programme for now but will consider it.
Q1 gross margin rose on product mix plus inflation correction; management says gross margin will move up and down by quarter but the annual target holds.

qa_highlights.question: Why did gross margin expand YoY and QoQ, and will it sustain?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited a mix of product mix and inflation correction; it expects the average annual gross margin of about 60% to hold, with quarterly swings possible.

qa_highlights.question: Did the Haryana and UP minimum wage hikes hit employee costs?
qa_highlights.answer: Yes; Haryana wages rose about 30-35% and that cost is in Q1. Management said the full quarter's impact is captured and there is no further large impact.

qa_highlights.question: What happened to the INR25 crore loan to a real estate developer?
qa_highlights.answer: INR10 crore was repaid in Q1; the remaining INR15 crore is due by about February. Management said such transactions will not recur.

qa_highlights.question: Is the INR1,000 crore revenue target achievable and what drives it?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the target is on track, with new stores, SSG and online as drivers, and Q2 openings expected to recover the Q1 shortfall.

qa_highlights.question: Why has ROCE fallen and how are inventory days being managed?
qa_highlights.answer: Finished goods inventory days fell to 114 in FY26 from 121 in FY25; working capital days fell to about 100 from 110. Management aims for 110-120 days and says ROCE is about 40%.

qa_highlights.question: Why has franchise (FOCO) count declined?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said bigger store formats need larger investment, which franchisees in Tier 3 towns are not willing to make, and most stores are in Tier 2 and beyond.

risks_watch: PAT margin flat at 9.1% despite EBITDA margin gain of about 230 bps; watch depreciation and Ind AS effects from larger stores.
Volume growth of about 7-8% lags 13% area growth; management guides for a pickup only in Q3 with Diwali in November.
Festive timing shift (Raksha Bandhan late August) could weigh on Q2 SSG; management declined to comment on the current quarter.
Cotton and raw material cost pressure; management expects prices to correct but gave no basis, and pass-through is assumed to hold.
Franchise store count down from 178 (FY23) to 130 and falling, which slows the asset-light model.
Online share fell to 5% in Q1 during a software integration; the 8% FY27 target depends on this migration.
Working capital cycle guided at 100-105 days; inventory ageing needs monitoring.
Management was not forthcoming on the INR15 crore receivable beyond a February repayment date, and call quality limited several questions.
summary.management_tone: Confident on full-year targets (INR1,000 crore revenue, 5% SSG, 30%+ EBITDA margin) and reassuring on margins. Cautious on the current quarter, which management called too early to judge, and it deferred volume recovery to Q3.
